semiconductor_relevance: High — Hi-Nano specializes in precision laser micromachining technologies that are critical for processing advanced semiconductor materials.
summary: Hi-Nano Optoelectronics Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focused on precision laser micromachining, offering solutions for the processing of advanced materials such as optical glass and silicon carbide. Their expertise includes TGV technology integration and ultra-precision drilling, making them a valuable partner in the semiconductor manufacturing process.
capabilities: Precision laser micromachining for optical glass and ceramics
Ultra-precision hole diameter control with ±0.5 μm tolerance
High-volume production with near 100% yield rates
